name: ImprintX
name_zh: 知行具身（北京）科技有限公司
summary: ImprintX is a Beijing-based developer of tactile sensing hardware, data acquisition and perception technology for robot manipulation. Its physical portfolio includes the event-driven Imprint X visuotactile sensor and the Imprint Glove system of fingertip sensors and wrist hubs.
